summary: refactor(shared): move app email imports to @fxa/shared/email
description:
Because:
- fxa-settings, the content-server app and the auth-server config still import email code from fxa-shared.

This commit:
- Moves popularDomains.json to @fxa/shared/email and ports its spec to jest.
- Changes fxa-settings and content-server app imports to @fxa/shared/email.
- Adds the lib to the settings jest mapper and the content-server webpack alias.
- Changes the auth-server popular domains config to require @fxa/shared/email.
- Removes the fxa-shared email shims, the barrel key and the JSON exports entry.

Closes FXA-14697
